name: motion-bounce-squash
title: CustomBounce with Squash
description: Quả bóng rơi nảy nhiều lần, chỉ bẹp đúng khung chạm đất và bẹp yếu dần qua mỗi lần nảy.

moworks.author: takayu

options.squash: at the first contact (0.32 here; 0.5 × (1 − p))

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-custombounce, written here): Recipe: first contact at 400 ms; each bounce keeps 70 % of the previous height (strength 0.7) and lasts √0.7 of the previous, ~1200 ms in all; squash only on the 1–2 contact frames, weaker each bounce, origin bottom; slight stretch in the fast fall. Site demo: bounce.out over 1600 ms, 112 px drop (contacts at 36 / 73 / 91 %), squash = 0.5·(1 − p) within 4 % of the floor: scaleY 0.68 / 0.86 / 0.95, scaleX 1 + the same amount. Params: strength (0.7) · squash đầu (0.32) · duration (1.2 s) · origin (đáy).
